description: Flash-analyzer overlay sequences (OSC-OVERLAY). Written by tools/limiter-overlay-vectors.py; see conformance/limiter/README.md.

sequences.name: no-overlay-is-inert
sequences.derivation: The small caption flicker with no overlay set: no general transitions, no overlay report.

sequences.name: caption-small-flicker-measure
sequences.derivation: 0.05 to 0.12 swings at 10 Hz in the 12 caption cells: below the 0.1 general change, at least the 0.05 overlay change, so overlay transitions only.

sequences.name: caption-small-flicker-admit
sequences.derivation: The same under admit: overlay transitions beyond 2 a second are refused and the last admitted image stays.

sequences.name: bright-darker-end
sequences.derivation: 0.85 to 0.95 at 5 Hz: the darker end is above the general 0.8 limit, below the overlay's 1.0.

sequences.name: area-fraction
sequences.derivation: max_area 0.25 over the caption: flicker in 3 of its 12 cells is not more than a quarter, so no overlay transition; 4 cells is.

sequences.name: set-and-clear-mid-sequence
sequences.derivation: The overlay is set at frame 30 and cleared at frame 60; trackers carry over.

sequences.name: menu-feather-and-gap
sequences.derivation: A feathered menu region over the top-left cells, a 400 ms gap and a reset.
